__Fixed Spawn Locations__

If there are no directions, then the spawns are within the map marker and easy to locate.

__Ash Heap__

**Lake Reynolds**

External

Mirelurk Crab x4

Mirelurk Hunter x1

OR

Mirelurk Crab x2

Mirelurk Hunter x2

__Forest__

**Arktos Pharma**

Internal

Mirelurk Hunter x2

Downloadable map __here__

From the spawn location, head west toward the building.

Enter through the door near the ground-floor stairs, go behind the reception desk, and take the elevator down to the Biome Lab.

Exit the elevator and face north, stopping at the machine in the center of the room. Turn southwest and look for the “Habitat C” sign on the wall, partially covered in vines. Head to the large hole beneath the sign and follow the path marked by the yellow line on the floor to enter Habitat C.

The first Mirelurk Hunter spawns beneath the green metal stairs you walk down. You may need to pass under the stairs a few times for it to appear.

Return to the bottom of the stairs and face west. Walk forward until you reach the wall on the far side of the habitat. The second spawn appears near the Kaleidopore flower on your left.

**New River Gorge Resort**

External

Mirelurk Crab x5

From the spawn-in location, run forward past all the buildings and head to the back of the resort, where the pool is, for three mirelurk spawns.

From the pool area, face south and walk forward, jumping over the small stone wall. Continue until you reach the cabin ahead. The entrance to the cabin is under the floor on the southwest side, but the last two mirelurks will usually come out to meet you if you wait by the underfloor entrance.

**Poseidon Power Station PX-02**

External

Mirelurk Crab x2

From the spawn-in location, follow the road straight ahead and stop when you reach the North 91 sign on your right. Turn to face north, then run forward and jump over the wire fence. Continue by either walking around or jumping over the metal fence until you are standing at the edge of the treatment pits. Jump down into the pits and run around, and the two mirelurks will spawn.

**Summersville**

External

Mirelurk Crab x3

From the spawn-in location, turn west and run forward until you reach the river. Turn left and follow the river upstream, and the three mirelurks will spawn.

**Ohio River Adventures**

External

Mirelurk Crab x5

From the spawn-in location, turn east and run out to the road. Turn left and follow the road until you see the stone wall on your right. The first mirelurk will spawn by the stone wall or on the road opposite.

Stand at the stone wall and face west, then walk toward the river. The next mirelurk has a bit of a random spawn. Sometimes it appears near the fast travel point, and other times it spawns between the main road and the river, so use V.A.T.S. to locate it.

Stand on the edge of the river and face southwest. Follow the riverbank around, past the raider camp, and continue along past Jangles the Moon Monkey playing golf. Keep going and you will come across the last three mirelurks.

__Toxic Valley__

**Toxic Dried Lakebed**

External

Mirelurk Crab x5

Mirelurk Queen x1

**Grafton Steel**

External

Mirelurk Crab x1

From the spawn-in location, face west and run straight through the workshop until you reach the edge of the wall near the dam. Run along the pipes and jump into the water. The mirelurk will spawn on the small island to your right (north).

**Wendigo Cave**

Internal

Downloadable map __here__

**Uncanny Caverns**

External

Mirelurk Crab x1

From the spawn-in location, head toward the entrance to Uncanny Caverns. The mirelurk will spawn near the door.

**Uncanny Caverns**

Internal

Mirelurk Crab x8

Mirelurk King x3

Downloadable map __here__

**Miner's Monument**

External

Mirelurk Crab x4

From the spawn-in location, turn and face east. Run toward Whitespring Resort and jump the fence. Continue heading east until you reach the path. Follow the path until you come to a small guardhouse on your left. Next to the guardhouse is a small pond. You may need to jump into the water to trigger the mirelurk spawns.

**Spruce Knob Lake**

External

Mirelurk Crab x11

Mirelurk Queen x1

Mirelurk King x1

From the spawn in location, run straight forward and swim around in the water, and the Mirelurks will spawn. Some Mirelurks will also spawn around the Boat House on the left.

**Foundation**

External

Mirelurk Crab x3

From the spawn location, face west and count the monorail poles in front of you. Walk forward to the third pole. Stand at its base and face west again. Continue walking until you reach a small creek, then follow it to the right to find the Mirelurks.

**Note**: The eggs here can not be harvested.

External

From the spawn in location, turn right and run around to the back of the Motel. The mirelurk will spawn in the pool.

**Glass Caverns**

Internal

Mirelurk Crab x1

Mirelurk King x3

Downloadable map __here__

From the spawn location, jump down and enter the Glass Caverns.

Follow the train track west (there is only one direction you can go) and continue downhill until you reach the room with the yellow machinery and the first Scorchbeast corpse.

Face northeast and follow the track into the next room. Stay on the right-hand track, and two Mirelurk Kings will spawn on your left.

Continue following the track east until you reach a cross-junction. Turn right, pass the red gas bottles, and go through the door on your right. Jump down into the water, and the final two Mirelurks will spawn here.

**Atlantic City**

The Boardwalk

Mirelurk Crab x4

Mirelurk King x1

Downloadable map __here__

Once you load into The Boardwalk, face northeast and run to the doorway beneath the Nuka-Cherry sign. Follow the tunnel to the end and face east. Walk forward and jump down to the ground. A white wooden boat will be on your left with the first two Mirelurks nearby.

From that boat, face north and run to the black metal boat ahead. Head toward the back of the boat, and the final two Mirelurks will spawn.
